description: This file defines a wizard interface for setting filter fields in the 'base_report_creator' module of an OpenERP/Odoo project. It includes form definitions, domain setting functions, operator configuration, and a wizard class with multiple states for user interaction.

classes.name: set_filter_fields
classes.description: A wizard interface class for setting filter fields with multiple interaction states.

methods.name: _set_field_domain
methods.description: Sets the domain for the 'field_id' field based on the current model and context.

methods.name: set_field_operator
methods.description: Configures the search operator and value list based on field type and search operator.

methods.name: _set_filter_value
methods.description: Creates filter expressions based on user input and field properties.

methods.name: _set_form_value
methods.description: Prepares form values for the selected field, including operator and selection options.

methods.name: _set_operator
methods.description: Populates the list of available operators based on the field type.
